# jenkins_folder (Resource)

Creates a Jenkins Folder. Requires the cloudbees-folder plugin.

~> **Warning:** Destroying this resource deletes the folder **and everything it contains**, including jobs and nested folders.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jenkins_folder" "team" {
  name        = "team-a"
  description = "Jobs owned by team A"
}

# Nested folder, created at team-a/services
resource "jenkins_folder" "services" {
  name        = "services"
  parent      = jenkins_folder.team.id
  description = "Service pipelines"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the folder. Changing this forces a new folder to be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the folder.
- `parent` (String) Path of the parent folder, for example `team-a/services`. Leave unset to create the folder at the Jenkins root. Changing this forces a new folder to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Full path of the folder, for example `team-a/services`.

## Import

Import is supported using the full path of the folder:

```shell
terraform import jenkins_folder.services team-a/services
```
